boundaries.source: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS), OCHA ROAP; redistributed by geoBoundaries (gbOpen BGD ADM2/ADM3)
boundaries.source_dataset: HDX 'Administrative boundaries of Bangladesh as of 2015'

classes.hospital_types_source: scripts/build_statistics.py HOSPITAL_TYPES (same list as the Statistics and Research pages)
classes.public_hospital: hospital type AND ownership in Fully Government-owned, Government-Autonomous, Government-Semi-auonomous
classes.private_ngo_hospital: every other hospital-type record, including missing ownership

method.distance: straight-line km, grid cell centre to nearest mapped facility point, UTM 46N; land area shares, not population
method.registry_label_counts: DGHS administrative fields; include records without usable coordinates
method.point_counts: published coordinates only, point in polygon on simplified BBS/OCHA boundaries
